title: Bettter Wood & Stone Tools
description: This resourcepack reimagines the said Wood & Stone toolsets.
body:
This is my first ever real project, so it may not be the best.

This Resourcepack Reimagines the said Wood & Stone Toolsets and makes them look way more handmade and unprofessional.

This pack technically works for all versions, though it is recommended to use it AFTER 1.21.11 (Mounts of Mayhem), since the Wood & Stone Spears are included.
